metadata.name: partner_fee_share
metadata.description: On-chain partner fee distribution for Meteora DBC pools

instructions.name: claim_damm_v2
docs: CPI to Meteora DAMM V2 to claim LP position fees (post-graduation).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can crank this instruction.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The base token mint.

accounts.name: fee_share_authority
docs: The authority PDA that holds the LP NFT and receives fees (transient — split immediately).

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Receives creator's split atomically.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: v2 — Platform vault PDA. Receives platform's split atomically.

accounts.name: authority_wsol_account
docs: The authority PDA's WSOL token account. Receives WSOL from DAMM V2 claim,
then closed to unwrap → native SOL.

accounts.name: meteora_damm_v2_program
docs: Meteora DAMM V2 program — must match the hardcoded program ID.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token program — needed to close the WSOL account after claim.

accounts.name: program_config
docs: Global program config — for paused check.

instructions.name: claim_dbc
docs: CPI to Meteora DBC to claim partner trading fees into the authority PDA.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can crank this instruction.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The base token mint.

accounts.name: fee_share_authority
docs: The authority PDA that receives Meteora fees (transient — split immediately).

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Receives creator's split atomically.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: v2 — Platform vault PDA. Receives platform's split atomically.

accounts.name: authority_wsol_account
docs: The authority PDA's WSOL token account. Receives WSOL from DBC claim,
then closed to unwrap → native SOL.

accounts.name: meteora_dbc_program
docs: Meteora DBC program — must match the hardcoded program ID.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token program — needed to close the WSOL account after claim.

accounts.name: program_config
docs: Global program config — for paused check.

instructions.name: claim_platform
docs: Platform operator/admin withdraws the platform's fee share.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: v2 — Platform vault PDA. Drained to the platform_wallet.

instructions.name: claim_user
docs: Creator withdraws their accumulated fee share.

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Drained to the creator wallet.

instructions.name: confirm_admin
docs: Pending admin confirms the admin rotation.

instructions.name: distribute_creator
docs: Operator/admin distributes accumulated creator fees to the creator's wallet.

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Drained to the creator wallet.

instructions.name: init_program_config
docs: Initialize the global program config singleton. Called once by the initial admin.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initialize a per-token fee share config. Called at pool launch time.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Operator who pays for and creates this config.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The base token mint for this pool.

accounts.name: program_config
docs: Global program config — operator must match.

accounts.name: fee_share_config
docs: PDA that stores the fee config and ledger.

accounts.name: fee_share_authority
docs: PDA that acts as the Meteora partner fee claimer and post-grad LP NFT holder.
Transient SOL receiver — split immediately into creator_vault + platform_vault
inside every claim instruction.

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Holds the creator's split of every claim.
Created by transferring the rent-exempt minimum from the payer; owned by System Program.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: v2 — Platform vault PDA. Holds the platform's split of every claim.

instructions.name: migrate_to_v2
docs: One-time migration of a v1-launched FeeShareConfig to the v2 split-vault
architecture. Initializes creator_vault + platform_vault and routes any
co-mingled SOL from fee_share_authority into them per the v1 ledger.

accounts.name: fee_share_authority
docs: Existing v1 authority PDA — drained into the new vaults.

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: New creator vault — pre-funded with rent-exempt minimum from authority.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: New platform vault — pre-funded with rent-exempt minimum from authority.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Guardian or admin pauses the program.

instructions.name: reclaim_expired
docs: Admin reclaims expired unclaimed creator fees.

accounts.name: creator_vault
docs: v2 — Creator vault PDA. Source of the reclaim.

accounts.name: platform_vault
docs: v2 — Platform vault PDA. Destination of the reclaim.

instructions.name: set_graduated
docs: Operator/admin marks a pool as graduated and stores DAMM V2 references.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The operator or admin wallet.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The base token mint.

accounts.name: program_config
docs: Global program config — operator or admin must match.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Guardian or admin unpauses the program.

instructions.name: update_creator
docs: Operator (first-assign) or admin (reassign) updates the creator wallet.

accounts.name: authority

docs: The base token mint.

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not the admin

errors.name: UnauthorizedCreator
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not the creator

errors.name: NotGraduated
errors.msg: Pool has not graduated to DAMM V2 yet

errors.name: AlreadyGraduated
errors.msg: Pool is already marked as graduated

errors.name: NoCreatorAssigned
errors.msg: No creator assigned — cannot distribute to placeholder address

errors.name: PendingAdminMismatch

types.name: FeeShareConfig
docs: Per-token fee share configuration and ledger.
Stores the creator/platform split, pool references, and accumulated fee balances.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: The base token mint this config is for.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump for the fee_share_authority PDA.

fields.name: config_bump
docs: Bump for this fee_share_config PDA.

fields.name: admin
docs: Platform admin wallet — can call claim_platform, reclaim_expired, set_graduated.

fields.name: creator
docs: Creator wallet — receives creator_bps share of fees.

fields.name: creator_bps
docs: Creator's share in basis points (e.g., 3600 = 36%).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: Meteora DBC pool address.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: Per-token DBC config address (feeClaimer = fee_share_authority).

fields.name: damm_v2_pool
docs: DAMM V2 pool address (set after graduation, default = SystemProgram).

fields.name: partner_lp_nft_mint
docs: Partner LP NFT mint for DAMM V2 fee claiming (default = SystemProgram).

fields.name: is_graduated
docs: Whether the DBC pool has graduated to DAMM V2.

fields.name: total_harvested_lamports
docs: Total SOL (lamports) harvested from Meteora across all claims.

fields.name: creator_earned_lamports
docs: Creator's cumulative earned share (lamports).

fields.name: creator_claimed_lamports
docs: Creator's total withdrawn amount (lamports).

fields.name: platform_claimed_lamports
docs: Platform's total withdrawn amount (lamports).

fields.name: last_harvest_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last Meteora fee harvest.

fields.name: expiry_duration_seconds
docs: Configurable expiry duration in seconds (default 90 days).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp.

fields.name: creator_vault_bump
docs: Bump for the creator_vault PDA (v2).

fields.name: platform_vault_bump
docs: Bump for the platform_vault PDA (v2).

fields.name: _padding
docs: Reserved for future use.
